title: Selected-sign expectation for the pair triple
statement: Let $(U,V,-V)$ be a triple formed from two independent uniform signs. For Boolean selectors $a,b,c$, replace each coordinate whose selector is false by $1$ and take the product of the resulting three real signs. Its expectation is $(-1)^b$ if $a$ is false and $b=c$, and is $0$ otherwise.
